name: @hahlex/millar-monorepo
description: Millar: Official Hahlex Design System (Foundations, Marketing, Product, Portal & MCP Server)

scripts.build:packages: pnpm run compile && pnpm --filter @hahlex/millar-core run build && pnpm --filter @hahlex/millar-tokens run build && pnpm --filter @hahlex/millar-validator run build && pnpm --filter @hahlex/millar-ui run build && pnpm --filter @hahlex/millar-domain-education run build && pnpm --filter @hahlex/millar-marketing run build && pnpm --filter @hahlex/millar-mcp run build && pnpm --filter millar run build
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @hahlex/millar-portal run build
scripts.deploy:portal: pnpm --filter @hahlex/millar-portal run build && pnpm --filter @hahlex/millar-portal run deploy
scripts.deploy:portal:dry-run: pnpm --filter @hahlex/millar-portal run build && pnpm --filter @hahlex/millar-portal run deploy:dry-run
scripts.verify: pnpm run check:em-dash && pnpm run check:governance && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
